speaker: Sheldon
text: What a remarkable woman. I envy you your childhood.

speaker: Leonard
text: Yeah, I I thought you guys might hit it off. I hate to tell you, but the only warm memories I have of my childhood are of my Uncle Floyd.

speaker: Sheldon
text: But you're clearly misremembering. Your mother is brilliant, analytical, insightful, and I'm betting she never hit you with a Bible because you wouldn't eat your Brussels sprouts.

speaker: Leonard
text: Gentlemen, you don't give your mother enough credit. She's warm, she's loving. She doesn't glue electrodes to your head to measure your brain waves while potty training.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You were lucky. When I was a kid, if I wanted an EEG, I had to attach my own electrodes.

speaker: Howard
text: So, Dr. Hofstadter, Leonard rarely talks about his incredibly successful brother and sister. So she's close to curing diabetes.

speaker: Leonard
text: Please don't go there, Howard.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I understand that unlike Leonard, they're at the top of their respective fields. Boy, you suck.

text: Well, Leonard's younger brother Michael is a tenured law professor at Harvard and his sister just successfully grew a human pancreas in an adolescent gibbon. Why else would you grow a pancreas in a teenage gibbon?

speaker: Howard
text: Wow, you must be very proud.

speaker: Dr. Beverly Hofstadter
text: Why? They're not my accomplishments. I have to urinate.

speaker: Howard
text: Why are you doing this? You know the rules. You brought your mom to work. You must suffer.

text: I had no idea your siblings were so much more successful than you.

speaker: Howard
text: Yeah, you're like the Jar Jar Binks of the Hofstadter family. Oh, Misa, thank you so much. I'm so sorry.

speaker: Leonard
text: You know, rather than mock me, my friends might realize that this is difficult and try to help me through it.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Nope, I think mocking you is more fun.

speaker: Howard
text: Next time, don't you stop bringing mama to work, okay?

text: That was fast.

text: The middle stall was occupied. I'll have to try again later.
